description: This source file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeSkillAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various API endpoints such as getOne, update, delete, create, and getAll for employee skills, including validation rules and service interactions.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPITest
classes.description: This class contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeSkillAPI class, covering methods like getOne, update, delete, create, getAll, and their respective validation rules.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillService
methods.description: Verifies that the API's getEmployeeSkillService method returns an instance of EmployeeSkillService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single Employee Skill, mocks DAO and Service interactions, and validates output normalization and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks validation rules for fetching a specific employee skill, ensuring proper request validation.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee skill, including DAO interactions and output validation.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the request rules for updating employee skills.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting employee skills, ensuring DAO delete method is called and response is as expected.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks validation rules for delete API calls.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee skill, verifying DAO save interaction and output correctness.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates request rules for creating employee skills.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests fetching all employee skills for an employee, including counting and search functionality.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Checks validation rules for fetching all skills endpoint.
